Sheet.Label: Velvet Loot Reveal — Chest / Loot / Vault

Aria.Items: Loot items. Use the left and right arrow keys to browse.

Offer.Text: How do you want to open this loot?

Warn.NoNativeSheet: No other sheet is registered for this actor type. Use Configure Sheet to change it.
Warn.NoRecipient: Assign a character to your user or select one of your tokens to receive the loot.
Warn.NoPickup: The GM has disabled picking up loot from this view.
Warn.NoGM: A GM must be connected to pick up loot.
Warn.Timeout: The GM did not answer the pickup request.
Warn.NotOwner: You do not own the character that would receive the item.
Warn.ItemGone: That item is no longer there.
Warn.NotRevealed: That item has not been revealed yet.

enabled.Name: Enable Velvet Loot Reveal
enabled.Hint: Master switch. When off, no buttons are added and loot opens as usual.

itemPiles.Name: Enable Item Piles integration
itemPiles.Hint: Use the cinematic view for Item Piles piles and containers. Item Piles keeps handling storage and transfers.

autoOffer.Name: Automatically offer cinematic view
autoOffer.Hint: When someone interacts with a pile, ask whether to open the Loot Reveal or the normal loot sheet.

autoOpen.Name: Automatically open cinematic view
autoOpen.Hint: Open the Loot Reveal straight away when interacting with a pile. The normal sheet stays one button away.

revealMode.Name: Reveal mode
revealMode.Hint: Immediate: items are visible at once. Player interaction: each player uncovers items on their own screen. GM controlled: players see ??? until the GM presses Reveal.

syncReveal.Name: Synchronize reveal to players
syncReveal.Hint: When the GM shows loot to players, their carousel follows the GM's selection and closes with the GM's.

playerNavigation.Name: Allow player navigation
playerNavigation.Hint: Players can browse the carousel themselves.

playerPickup.Name: Allow player pickup
playerPickup.Hint: Players can take items from the cinematic view.

showPrice.Name: Show price
showPrice.Hint: Display the item's cost in the information panel.

showLevel.Name: Show item level
showLevel.Hint: Display the item level when the system has one.

showTraits.Name: Show traits
showTraits.Hint: Display the item's traits or properties.

sounds.Name: Enable sounds
sounds.Hint: Play interface sounds on this client.

volume.Name: Sound volume
volume.Hint: Volume of the Loot Reveal sounds, on top of Foundry's interface volume.

raritySounds.Name: Rarity sounds
raritySounds.Hint: Use a different reveal sound for each rarity.

navigationSounds.Name: Navigation sounds
navigationSounds.Hint: Play a tick when moving through the carousel.

pickupSounds.Name: Pickup sounds
pickupSounds.Hint: Play a sound when taking an item.

animations.Name: Enable animations
animations.Hint: Turn off for a static view. The system's reduced-motion preference is always respected.

particles.Name: Enable particles
particles.Hint: Burst of particles when a rare item is revealed.

rarityGlow.Name: Enable rarity glow
rarityGlow.Hint: Coloured glow behind the selected item.
